Colour by "rs-fMRI delay" paints every arterial point with the group-average rapidtide delay of the JHU L1 territory it lies in (nearest territory within 8 mm for surface vessels); tick "JHU delay territories" to see the map itself.

Hover a vessel for its name, parent chain and territory. Click to highlight it and its path back to the source. Click a legend entry to hide it; double-click to show only that group.

Built from BrainCharter group maps (ToF arteries, SWI veins; 41 subjects, MNI). Each tree is grown from its roots (ICA L/R, basilar; torcular and sigmoid L/R) by minimal-cost paths through vessel probability, so every segment is connected to a source. Names come from tree topology and the JHU territories each branch reaches. They are approximate. The transverse sinus is weak in the SWI atlas. The atlas shows no vessels below about z = −55 mm.
ARTERIES · colour = rs-fMRI delay of the territory each point lies in
VEINS · colour = mean delay of the territories each segment drains
